```{r}
#| include: true
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("Repi.target") || length(Repi.target) != 1L) Repi.target <- 100
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- c("0.10", "0.16", "0.50", "0.84", "0.90")
TRT.target <- GMPETable[ID %in% ID.target, TRT][1]
# Snap here too: the caption must quote the cells actually plotted.
AUX <- sort(unique(GMPETable[ID %in% ID.target, Repi]))
Repi.target <- AUX[which.min(abs(log(AUX) - log(Repi.target)))]
AUX <- sort(unique(GMPETable[ID %in% ID.target, Mw]))
Mw.target <- AUX[which.min(abs(Mw.target - AUX))]
rm(AUX)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Median response spectra Sa(Tn) [g] for the %s ground-motion model set at Mw = %s and Repi = %.0f km, reference rock condition Vs30 = 760 m/s and 5%% critical damping. The weighted mixture is reported at quantiles p = %s; the shaded band spans the 5th to 95th percentiles of the conditional distribution."
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: fig-gmpe-psa
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP |> sprintf(TRT.target, Mw.target, Repi.target, paste(p.target, collapse = ", "))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig/GMPE.PSA.R"))
PLOT
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("CAP", "Repi.target", "dep.target", "TRT.target"), ls()))
```
